title: The Shape of Risk: Dynamic Regime Shifts in Factor Models for Market Portfolio Optimization

contributions.purpose: 让因子暴露随隐状态切换,而非只切波动率/截距
contributions.mechanism: 在Fama-French五因子上加Hamilton马尔可夫切换,状态相关回归+EM(前向-后向)估计+参数bootstrap检验
contributions.evaluation: 似然检验拒绝常数beta假设;Bear态市场beta升至~1.6且SMB转负,Bull态SMB转正(数值来自图,论文未内嵌图)
contributions.domain: 资产定价 / 组合优化(AI生成研究)
contributions.source_quote: We embed regime dependence directly in factor loadings, rather than only in volatility or intercepts.

contributions.mechanism: 36个月滚动OLS beta + 状态相关beta估计
contributions.evaluation: 市场beta在0.7-1.7间震荡,HML/CMA/SMB频繁变号(H1)
contributions.source_quote: market beta (MKT_RF) oscillates between 0.7 and 1.7, while HML, CMA, and SMB frequently change sign.

contributions.mechanism: 用滤波状态概率映射为动态组合配置
contributions.evaluation: 1980-2025 regime-aware策略财富near triples,超静态基准>25%,更高Sharpe/CEQ;Bear概率与VIX相关>0.6(H2/H3)
contributions.source_quote: By 2025, the regime-aware allocation nearly triples initial wealth, outperforming the static benchmark by over 25%.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We extend the Fama-French five-factor framework (Fama and French, 1993; Fama and French, 2015) by allowing factor exposures to switch across latent regimes (Hamilton, 1989).
